description: Writes a resolved incident's post-mortem: summary, impact, root cause and follow-ups (one per line), on Pro plans. It stays in the workspace until published: true shows it under the incident on the status pages that show it and in their feeds; false takes it off. Publish only when the user asks. Free.

follow_ups.description: What will be done so it does not happen again, one per line.

impact.description: Who and what was affected, and for how long.

published.description: true shows the post-mortem on the status pages that show the incident; false takes it off. Leave out to keep it as it is.

summary.description: What happened, in a few sentences.

name: write_postmortem
title: Write or publish a post-mortem
